title: Screen Text Capture Editor
description: Screen Text Capture Editor. 2 recovered saves.
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: SCREEN TEXT CAPTURE EDITOR
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Ordered lines, consistent pointers, normal end marker, byte-identical both-channel recoveries; runtime untested
versions.unavailableReason: Another recovered save; the site offers one selected player.
versions.startupSource:
10 CLEAR1700
20 DIMA$(15)
100 A$=INKEY$
110 IFVAL(A$)>0ORA$="0"THENN=VAL(A$)+N*10
120 IFA$="Q"THENFORX=1TON:L=L-64:NEXT:N=0
130 IFA$="W"THENFORX=1TON:L=L+64:NEXT:N=0
140 IFA$="E"THENFORX=1TON:L=L-1:NEXT:N=0
150 IFA$="R"THENFORX=1TON:L=L+1:NEXT:N=0
160 IFA$=" "THEN2000
170 IFA$="D"THENPRINT@0,"";:FORX=0TOX1:PRINTA$(X);:NEXT:N=0
180 IFA$="S"THENX1=N:N=0
500 GOSUB1500
